headline_sentences.chat_subset: The instruction-tuned/chat subset of that denominator is n=36 (36/139 of the eligible undeclared rows), with 0 firing at the refit threshold, Wilson 95% [0.000, 0.096] -- an n this small cannot support a pooled rate standing in for the population actually at risk of abliteration.
headline_sentences.detection_iff_completion: Whenever discovery holds -- that is, whenever the removed direction is the Gram's minimal direction -- detection and completion are the same statement, as a CONSEQUENCE OF THE DEFINITION of W05 rather than as an empirical finding; and where discovery fails the completion criterion is not merely false but undefined, because there is no r for the statistic to have found.
headline_sentences.isometry: Let H = I - 2 u u^T be a Householder reflection and let every residual-write matrix W be replaced by H W. H is orthogonal, so it removes no rank and leaves every singular value of W unchanged; consequently the shared Gram matrix A = sum_l W W^T / ||W||_F^2 is conjugated by H, its spectrum is invariant, and every per-matrix write-energy distribution is invariant up to the same rotation of the eigenbasis. Therefore ANY statistic that is a function of the Gram spectrum is blind to the edit -- W05, W05q10, W05w, and every windowed or banded variant included.
headline_sentences.near_orthogonality: Detectability and effectiveness are near-orthogonal over the kernel sweep: rho = 0.113 with a bootstrap 95% interval of [-0.641, 0.700] over 13 kernels. The interval is what makes 'near-orthogonal' sayable -- a point estimate alone would not.
headline_sentences.operating_point: Holding out a single recipe class moves the fitted operating point by 1.026 log10 units (from -2.7415 to -1.7156), about 8.0 times the 0.128 log10 shift that already introduces the first false positive on the eligible undeclared population -- so the threshold is not merely brittle, it is essentially arbitrary at the scale the at-scale positives imply.
headline_sentences.specificity: Specificity is a property of the FIXED operating point, not of the statistic: 0/139 eligible undeclared checkpoints fire at tau=-2.7415, but 13/139 fire at the class-held-out refit threshold tau=-1.7156 (rate 0.094, Wilson 95% [0.055, 0.153)]. The narrow honest claim is therefore that zero false positives is achieved AT A THRESHOLD FITTED ON THE PANEL, and does not survive refitting.
headline_sentences.undefinedness: The single-direction discovery rule is undefined for exactly 12 of the 44 scored real edited checkpoints (the R_MULTIDIR_SVD and R_HERETIC classes) and for 5 of the in-house kernels; a rule that cannot be evaluated on the classes where the statistic fails is not yet a mechanism for those classes.
headline_sentences.what_the_sweep_shows: The genuinely empirical content of the kernel sweep is WHICH kernels achieve discovery, and that the discovery threshold is controlled by the kernel's MINIMUM depth weight, bracketed here in [0.07955950871822769, 0.5310959910353452] -- not by uniformity and not by how completely the peak layer is annihilated, which is total at every Gaussian spread.
